title: P@x model list
description: The providers P@x can use, each by an identifier with an adapter family (ADR-0004, amended 12 November 2026), the models offered for each, and their prices. Read from /etc/tur/pax/models.json if it exists, else /usr/share/tur/pax/models.json; never written by P@x. Model names and prices are configuration, never compiled in (ADR-0004). A model the person types that is not listed is accepted; its price is then not known and P@x limits it in tokens. The loader in services/tur-pax (settings.rs) is authoritative and also enforces: a provider is listed once; a model name is listed once per provider, with no control characters and no surrounding whitespace; prices follow the rules of the provider configuration (finite, not negative, a currency of 1 to 8 letters). The adapter families' own companies (anthropic, openai, google) exist without an entry, at their public addresses and with no prices.

status.description: example: figures read on one day to show the format, not kept up to date. maintained: a list its publisher keeps up to date.

prices_as_of.description: The day the prices were read.

id.description: The provider's identifier, by which settings, the interface and the keyring name it.

adapter.description: The adapter family that speaks its interface. The loader accepts the families the provider layer has: anthropic (Messages), openai (Responses), google (Interactions).

data_terms_url.description: Where the provider says how it handles data sent to its interface. Shown with the consent text.

key_url.description: Where a person gets a key.

max_output_tokens.description: P@x's own limit for one response with this model.

tested_with_tur.description: Whether the project ran its conformance tests against this model.

prices.description: Per million tokens. Absent when the price is not known or cannot be stated in this form.

base_url.description: Its address, if it is not the public address of its adapter family: https, or http for a loopback host only.

keyring_item.description: The name of the password store item that holds its key. Its identifier when absent.

capabilities.description: What it declares it can do. Recorded and reported; the adapter finds out whether it is true.
